title: ClearLedger prod: reserved throughput shortfall + GPU pool saturation — urgent
text:
ClearLedger prod: reserved throughput shortfall + GPU pool saturation — urgent

["From: ops@clearledger.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: kevin.li@clearledger.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High error rate + latency spikes in production - urgent

Vanessa,

We're seeing a major increase in 5xx errors and token-level latency for our ClearLedger production routes starting ~08:45 PT. Error rate jumped from ~0.5% to 6% and median token latency moved from ~45ms to ~350ms. This is impacting invoice generation and causing downstream retries.

Attached is an example of the error payloads. Can you confirm if this is on Redwood's side or something we've done? We have a billing cycle tonight so impact is time-sensitive. Please escalate.

—Kevin Li
Head of Integrations, ClearLedger
kevin.li@clearledger.com

Attachments: clearledger-error-sample.txt (text)
", "From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: ops@clearledger.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spikes in production - urgent

Kevin — thanks for the heads up and the sample; looking at it now. I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Success) and Soojin (Platform Ops) to triage. Immediate plan:

- Soojin will pull dedicated pool saturation metrics and check for anomalous scheduling/batching.
- If it's capacity-related we'll temporarily route ClearLedger to a compatible fallback model variant and enable aggressive per-customer KV cache for prefixes.
- Marissa will coordinate customer comms; I’ll request exec visibility if we can't stabilize within 2 hours.

Can you confirm whether you started any larger batch jobs around 08:30? Also share spike timestamps for all regions if available.

I’ll update within 15–20 mins.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spikes in production - urgent

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 09:28 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai wrote:
> Vanessa — thanks for the heads up and the sample; looking at it now. I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Success) and Soojin (Platform Ops) to triage. Immediate plan:

Quick telemetry summary (attaching chart):
- GPU dedicated pool eu-west-1a (pool-id: p-9f3b) at 09:05 PT hit sustained 98% GPU util for queued tokens, concurrent KV cache eviction spiked.
- Token queue depth increased ~6x for ClearLedger routes; preemption and continuous batching delays rose ~220ms per request.
- A small subset of tenant burst clients also triggered batch size growth; combined effect saturated headroom.

Immediate mitigations applied at 10:02 PT:
1) Reduced default batch size for ClearLedger from 32 -> 8 (expected latency delta ~ -180ms).
2) Pinned ClearLedger to a lower-capacity model variant (redwood/llm-slim-v2) to reduce per-token memory.
3) Enabled aggressive prefix caching and disabled a non-essential heavy-function hook in their route.

So far error rate has reduced to ~1.8% and median token latency to ~120ms. We are watching. I’ve attached pool-metrics-20270618.png and a draft MOP.

Next ask for platform engineering (Vivek): can we confirm if allocation logic respected reserved capacity for DL-4721 or if there was overcommit from burst pool? If allocation drift occurred, we'll need an immediate reconciliation and a short-term bump.

Attachments: pool-metrics-20270618.png, mop-runbook-v2.pdf

—Soojin Lee
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
", "From: kevin.li@clearledger.com

Cc: ops@clearledger.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spikes in production - urgent

Thanks for the fast mitigation. Two asks from our side:

1) Clear timeline — will this fully stabilize by end of day PT? Billing window is 22:00 PT and residual failures there would be critical.
2) Can we get an ESCALATION/exec contact to commit to an SLA credit or expedited recovery if we see reoccurrence this evening?

Appreciate the temporary fallback. We'll pause our scheduled batch at 11:30 PT and report if the signal reappears.

—Kevin
", "From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kevin.li@clearledger.com, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: ClearLedger production degradation — exec readout and next steps (INF-9124)

Folks — short exec summary for visibility and next actions (link to telemetry + Jira below). Customer (ClearLedger) saw a sudden spike in token queueing that coincided with cross-tenant burst activity in a dedicated pool. Key points:

- Impact: peak error rate ~6%, median token latency +300ms, customer-facing retries for invoice generation.
- Root cause (interim): pool headroom exhaustion driven by continuous batching growth and an unexpected allocation drift that allowed small burst tenants to grow batch sizes beyond anticipated limits.
- Immediate mitigations: reduced batch sizes, pinned to slim model variant, KV cache tuning. Customer error rate improved to ~1.5% within 45 mins.

Asks from leadership/infra:
1) Confirm whether reserved capacity guarantees were violated for deal DL-4721 and whether we should issue a temporary capacity bump today.
2) Approve customer-facing credit proposal (recommendation: 25% credit for tonight's billing window if any >1% error rate observed during 22:00–23:30 PT).
3) Engineering follow-up: deploy hotfix to allocation logic to enforce per-tenant batch size caps and add an alert on sustained KV eviction rate.

I’m suggesting a 30-minute exec bridge tonight at 20:00 PT if we still see elevated metrics. Please respond with yes/no and any alternative suggestions.

Links: JIRA INF-9124 (incident), Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqClearLedger-ops, Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the customer comms once we have a decision on credit & capacity bump.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
